CONTROL: Resonant imagines a New York twisted by the power of the enigmatic Hiss. This interdimensional force corrupts everything it touches, and all the iconic touchstones of New York are no exception; subway stations, pizza joints, and coffee shops are all filtered through the Hiss’s malevolent power. 

Of course, it wouldn’t be New York without its fair share of billboards, too. But these are no ordinary advertisements; the Hiss (and by proxy, those mad geniuses at Remedy Entertainment) had a ton of fun warping every day ad designs into mindbending, brain-breaking images. iam8bit adores these creative concoctions. So we’ve immortalized them for you here. 

This is the CONTROL Resonant: Billboard Bumper Stickers Pack. This set of 4 adhesive bumper stickers features designs straight from the game itself, rendered in all their glory. They come in FBC-Approved custom Containment Wrapping, too, to make the whole experience feel all the more official. Whether you’re decorating your laptop or just trying to weird out the next person bold enough to tailgate you, these stickers are sure to do the trick.

Persona 5 has stolen the hearts of millions of fans across the globe. The critically-acclaimed JRPG is so beloved, in fact, that it’s practically a franchise in its own right: Spin-Offs, the enhanced edition Royal, an anime special, stage plays, guest appearances in other games, and more all help shape the legend that is Persona 5. It remains one of the watershed moments of its console generation. 

Now, iam8bit and Atlus are joining forces to honor the legend of Persona 5 once again. This is the Persona 5 Essentials - Cassette Soundtrack! Its release marks the first time the music has ever been available on cassette. Songs like “The Whims of Fate,” “Life Will Change,” and of course, “Last Surprise” have been mastered for the format for the very first time ever.

products.body_html:

“The Persona 5 soundtrack makes every day feel cool” - The Verge

It’s back.

Persona 5 is a massive and epic opus of a game - the kind of 100-hour-plus JRPG journey that it is impossible to peel away from.

The soundtrack is equally epic, featuring hours of jazzy, poppy, energetic musical magic that you’ll find yourself unconsciously whistling throughout the day. From upbeat vocally-driven songs (many featuring the incomparable throaty gusto of Japanese soul singer, Lyn Inaizumi) to more contemplative, instrumental riffs, Atlus Sound Team assembled an impressive ensemble of tunes.

Quite simply, Persona 5 is one of iam8bit’s favorite video game soundtracks to date.

Now, together with Atlus, we’re reissuing one of our most popular, in-demand, frothed-at-the-mouth-for releases ever. This is the Persona 5 Vinyl Soundtrack - The Deluxe Edition 6xLP Reissue!

It’s the complete Persona 5 soundtrack, spread across 6 gorgeous, classic black vinyl discs, each with their own unique center label. The original album art from Drew Wise is back, too, in all its glory, complete with the special inner sleeves made to match Persona 5’s beloved cast. 

If you missed this crown jewel last time, now’s your chance to get it — but act fast. This special reissue is only available in limited quantities, built to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Persona 5. Don’t miss out.

products.title: Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Collector’s Edition)
products.body_html:
For decades, Tove Jansson’s pastoral world of Moomin has enchanted a worldwide audience of all ages. With countless comics, books, animated specials, and more under his belt, Moomintroll has now turned to the world of video games — and at just the perfect time, given the breakthrough smash success of the “cozy” genre. 

Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth is indeed a cozy adventure. Set in the frigid world of Moominland’s midwinter (and based loosely on the beloved book bearing that name), Winter’s Warmth sees players guiding Moomintroll through a beautiful landscape inspired by the Nordic countryside. 

At iam8bit, we never turn down the chance to celebrate a global icon like Moomintroll. That’s why we’re so pleased to team up with Hyper Games to bring you this finely crafted assortment of riches. This is the Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Collector's Edition)! Inside, you’ll find the game on disc, along with a trove of treasures. 

There’s a massive 172 page hardcover artbook, your behind-the-scenes look at the world of Winter’s Warmth and all the love and care that went into its creation. And if you’re paging through that book on the go, why not keep it in your brand-new, mega-fashionable, super-sturdy Moomin tote bag? Heck, while you’re at it: Decorate your tote with some snazzy 1.5” hard enamel pins. They come complete on high quality backer cards and feature Moomin designs from the game itself. If that’s not enough Moomin for you, you’re in luck. We’ve also included a super cute Moomintroll keychain, complete with scarf and celebratory smile. 

Plus, you’ll get everything inside the Retail Edition of Winter’s Warmth. That’s two kiss cut sticker sheets, found inside the game case, as well as a digital download code for the game’s chilled-out soundtrack.

Whether you’re returning to Moominvalley or visiting for the very first time, you’re going to find so much to love here. Don’t miss out!

Media Molecule’s LittleBigPlanet was, and remains, dramatically ahead of its time. A puzzle platformer that emphasized user-generated content and cooperative play, LittleBigPlanet embodied a spirit of player-driven creativity that has come to define the current generation of smash-hit games. 

Perhaps the most impressive thing about LittleBigPlanet was the way it managed to make such a big, robust gameplay concept feel so dang cozy and warm. Its textile-inspired textures and dulcet narration, courtesy of Stephen Fry, granted the game an unmistakable crafty charm. Creation, it seemed to insist, should be satisfying, uncomplicated, and fun.

That spirit is alive and well in the game’s unforgettable soundtrack. Composers Mat Clark and Kenneth C M Young stitched together a soundtrack that draws inspirations from world music, family-friendly nursery rhymes, groovy blended mashups, and beyond. iam8bit has always felt inspired by LittleBigPlanet’s undeniable pizzazz. That’s why we’re pleased as punch to team up with Sony Interactive Entertainment to bring it to vinyl. 

The LittleBigPlanet CD, much like its inspiration’s protagonist, packs a big punch from within a little package. On its two discs you’ll find 15 hand-selected tracks from the game, covering a delicious sampling platter of its rich cornucopia of moods. The album art, from illustrator Haley bbanditt Wakefield, celebrates the collage of muses that make LittleBigPlanet such a joy to experience. The result is an album that’s a true celebration of not just games, but creativity itself.

products.title: Wanderstop (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Burnout is a very real thing, friends, and sooner or later, it comes for us all. Whether you’re holding down a 9-to-5 or making a name for yourself as one of the greatest fighters in recorded history, life can sometimes feel relentless. It's in those moments that the best offense is a good defense, and learning to let go is the only true way to level up. 

Therein lies the thesis of Wanderstop, a meditation on burnout wrapped up in the guise of a fun, fantastical cozy tea shop manager. Developer Ivy Road, with help from publisher Annapurna Interactive, realized a world that reflects our own, populated by complex and caring characters each on their own personal journey regarding work, life, and the balance between. 

At iam8bit, we love Wanderstop’s resonant message. That’s why we’re so proud to present  —drumroll please — Wanderstop (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)! 

In addition to the game on disc, you’ll get an exclusive Wanderstop sticker pack featuring your favorite in-game fungi, perfect for adorning your tea mug. Plus, you’ll get a double-sided 12”x18’ foldout poster featuring Alta, Boro, and a veritable flock of chaotic lil’ pluffins. 

And since this is an iam8bit Exclusive Edition, you already know you’re getting an exclusive o-sleeve to decorate your game case and add wow to your shelf.

products.title: Persona 30th Anniversary Jazz Album (180 Gram Edition)

From the foundational themes in the first Persona to the sizzling hot songs that made Persona 5 an instant classic, Atlus Sound Team’s catchy soundtracks are now woven into the very fabric of not just JRPG history, but video game history as a whole.

Mankind is dead, blood is fuel, hell is full, and breakcore owns. These are the pillars on which smash hit indie shooter Ultrakill was forged. 

A New Blood Interactive joint, developed by the enigmatic Hakita, Ultrakill drips with gore, guts, and style. It fuses ultraviolent old-school FPS action with the speed and sophistication of modern character action games to create an experience all its own. 

Likewise, its music is the product of a beautiful, unholy union of influences. Hakita, by way of the rock/metal project Heaven Pierce Her, has crafted a distinctly gnarly soundscape that pairs MIDI-powered foundations with heavenly instrumentations and, of course, the ubiquitous Amen break. 

It rules, it slaps, and, in iam8bit’s humble opinion, it needs to be on vinyl. So we made it so.

A good spinoff lifts from its inspirations; a great spinoff dares to be a little different. Sackboy: A Big Adventure certainly falls into the latter camp. Developer Sumo Digital took the already refined platforming core of LittleBigPlanet and spun it into a lovable, family-friendly romp through a colorful and imaginative world. 

Winner of Best British Game and Best Family Game at the 2021 British Academy Games Awards, much of Sackboy’s distinctly English charm came from its warm, welcoming aesthetic — and, crucially, its equally warm and welcoming soundtrack. 

Sackboy’s soundtrack is a hummable, whimsical sonic odyssey packed toe to tip with delightful covers and lovely original compositions alike. It’s more than worthy of the vinyl treatment, so iam8bit is honored to team up with Sony Interactive Entertainment to immortalize it here for you. 

This is the Sackboy: A Big Adventure 2xLP. On its two discs, pressed on groovy Dreamer Orb Vinyl, you’ll find twenty tracks covering the whole dang adventure, from title theme to “The Final Showdown” and beyond. 

The album art is something to behold, too: Illustrator Haley bbanditt Wakefield crafted (get it?) cover art that captures Sackboy’s intrepid tiny-guy-in-a-big-world attitude. Inside, you’ll find a clever collage that actually forms a musical ledger in the shape of the game’s recurring musical riff. Media Molecule’s LittleBigPlanet was, and remains, dramatically ahead of its time. A puzzle platformer that emphasized user-generated content and cooperative play, LittleBigPlanet embodied a spirit of player-driven creativity that has come to define the current generation of smash-hit games. 

Perhaps the most impressive thing about LittleBigPlanet was the way it managed to make such a big, robust gameplay concept feel so dang cozy and warm. Ultrakill’s Act 2 descends deeper into the pits of Hell than its predecessor, casting players into perfectly polygonal levels filled with bedlam, blood, and bullets. products.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie 2xLP Vinyl Soundtrack

How do you follow up on one of the most acclaimed, successful animated films of all time? If you’re the team at Back Lot Music, Universal Pictures, Illumination and Nintendo, the answer is simple: Take it to the stars.

products.title: Adventure Time: Come Along with Me Soundtrack from the Animated Series CD
products.body_html:
“A good song can really wrap people up in a mood, better than any words alone could…”

Adventure Time’s three-episode-spanning finale explores the past, present, and future of Ooo, granting its beloved residents the wistful final farewell they more than deserve. Adventure Time: Come Along With Me is like a warm sunset; like hanging up the phone after an evening chat with an old friend; like the last weekend of summer vacation. It’s a bittersweet celebration of memories shared together, and a brave look into the future. 

The music of Come Along With Me reflects that ponderous, nostalgic mood. Like all of the show’s music, Tim Kiefer’s soundtrack plays with lo-fi arrangements and sincere songwriting to evoke powerful but guileless emotions. We at iam8bit couldn’t help but imagine it playing sweetly on a stereo, next to an open window and a spring breeze. So we teamed up with our friends at WaterTower Music to make that happen. 

This is the Adventure Time: Come Along with Me Soundtrack from the Animated Series CD, a two-disc physical manifestation of that indescribably Adventure Time magic. All the hits are here, including “Island Song” (that’s the main theme!) and Rebecca Sugar’s all-new original track “Time Adventure.” 

And just look at that album art: Background Designer and Visual Developer Jesse Balmer crafted a piece that somehow captures all the joy, melancholy, and majesty of Jake and Finn’s magical childhood. 

Come along with us and enjoy a one-of-a-kind soundtrack.

Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake tells a story filled with multiversal mishaps and misadventures, starring Fionna Campbell and her rambunctious feline companion Cake. Despite its high-concept premise, Fionna and Cake presents a more emotionally mature take on Adventure Time chaos, taking time to tell personal stories and ponder existential questions in between laugh-out-loud scenes filled with the series’ trademark sense of humor.

Here at iam8bit, we can’t stop banging our heads and tapping our toes to it, and we are so happy to team up with WaterTower Music to bring it to you here. 

Say hello to the Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake Soundtrack from the Animated Series CD, a two-disc jam-fest made special for your stereo. It’s all your favorite songs from seasons 1 & 2 of Fionna and Cake, composed by the brilliant Amanda Jones. You’ll hear guest performances from Rebecca Sugar, Tom Kenny, Brian David Gilbert, Open Mike Eagle, and more. It’s a real treat!

The album art, by Storyboard Artist Maya Petersen, celebrates the unbreakable bond between Fionna and Cake, reminding us of the friends who always have our backs. 

This one is pure magic, folks. Don’t miss it.

products.title: Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge)
products.body_html:
Here at iam8bit, its our firm belief that the preservation of video game history is crucial to the medium’s future as a commercial product, an art form, and everything in between. That’s why we’re so excited to partner with the Video Game History Foundation to bring you something truly special; a never-before-seen, long-lost prototype game from legendary programmer Chris Oberth. 

This is Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge), a fully functional NES title built from Oberth’s original design of the same name. First developed at Incredible Technologies Inc., the company behind coin-op classics like Golden Tee Golf, Big Buck Hunter, and more, Xcavator was shopped around to multiple publishers across the country way back in 1991, but it never found a home, and was quietly archived and never looked at again.

Recently, the prototype's source code was discovered and rebuilt by the Video Game History Foundation from Oberth's development archives, which were donated by his family after his unfortunate passing. Incredible Technologies then graciously agreed to donate the rights to the game to the VGHF to use as a fundraiser for its charitable work.

The Video Game History Foundation then worked with Mega Cat Studios to finish the game, staying true to Oberth’s original vision and using the tools and environments that Oberth would have utilized himself to make the game whole.

iam8bit took it from there, creating a truly unique and authentically retro package for Xcavator 2025 that includes a 14-page manual loaded with more info on Oberth and Xcavator, written by the fine folks of the VGHF themselves. It’s exhibit-quality stuff, available for your very own collection.

Best of all, 100% of the profits from the Xcavator 2025 NES Cartridge will go to fund the Video Game History Foundation, a 501(c)3 non-profit organization dedicated to preserving, celebrating, and teaching the history of video games.

This is a one-of-a-kind product made to support an important cause. Don’t miss your chance to be a part of video game history.

The in-game shanties are a huge part of the pirate life fantasy. They go beyond basic emotes, providing players with an opportunity to bond over music and merrymaking. It’s pure magic, and at iam8bit, we are so pleased to capture some of that magic and bring it to your turntable.

products.title: Fear the Spotlight (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
The horror genre has long been a vessel for telling rich, thematically-complex stories that would otherwise go untold. Fear the Spotlight continues that vital tradition. Developed by the husband and wife team Cozy Game Pals, Fear the Spotlight boldly presents something very rare in games: a well-realized love story that touches on themes of belonging, adolescence, and abandonment, all through the lens of a spine-tingling lo-fi horror that calls to mind classics like Silent Hill and Resident Evil. 

Vivian and Amy sneak into their school library after hours to perform a séance, but things quickly go horribly awry. The pair find themselves split up as they’re thrust into the dark, sinister history of their school. As terrifying spirits stalk the hallways, Vivian and Amy — across two parallel, playable storylines — must evade monsters, solve puzzles, and ultimately unravel the mysteries at the heart of Sunnyside High. 

iam8bit couldn’t be prouder to partner with our pals at Blumhouse Games to bring this gem to physical for the very first time. This is the Fear the Spotlight iam8bit Exclusive Edition, a celebration of one of this generation’s hidden treasures. 

This game really is THAT good - and will be considered an absolute classic for years to come!

In addition to the game on disc, you’ll get a scary and striking 12” x 18” poster featuring the game’s leads, Vivian and Amy. Plus, you’ll get an exclusive o-sleeve not available anywhere else, sure to make this edition stand out on your shelf.

You’ve just returned from the rental store with an armful of games. You dash down to the basement, set the TV to channel 3, and get ready for…an evening of jazz covers?

Seriously, these musicians are smile-inducingly good, performing familiar tunes from Ocarina of Time, Banjo-Kazooie, Sonic the Hedgehog, and more, with a decidedly magical moxie, as if from a bygone era, before video games even existed. products.title: Blue Eye Samurai 2xLP
products.body_html:
Set against the background of 17th-century Edo-period Japan, Netflix’s Blue Eye Samurai is a gorgeously-realized tale of revenge and resilience. Protagonist Mizu embarks on an undercover quest for vengeance against her father, setting off a story that touches on themes of identity and belonging – all while pushing the boundaries of sophisticated TV animation. 

It’s a series that wears its influences on its sleeve. Wife-husband creator duo Noizumi and Michael Green blended together Eastern and Western touchpoints, as well as 2D and 3D animation, to build something striking and singular. 

Likewise, the music of Blue Eye Samurai melds Eastern and Western influences, creating a sweeping, immersive sound that practically bathes the listener in its historical setting. Composer Amie Doherty pulled out all the stops, recording authentic Japanese instruments such as Shakuhachi, Shamisen, Taiko, and Hichiriki. The result is a distinct, beautiful and moody masterpiece. We, here at iam8bit, are humbled to bring it to vinyl. 

This is the Blue Eye Samurai 2xLP. It features the soundtrack from the award-winning first season of the hit show, pressed on Forged Steel Silver vinyl as a nod to Mizu’s legendary blade. 

The album artwork pays tribute to the stunning, unique look of Blue Eye Samurai. Longtime iam8bit friend and cohort Kevin Wilson cooked up a veritable visual feast that captures the show’s bold imagery as well as its moments of calm, confident quiet. 

Blue Eye Samurai is a modern animated classic. This album is our way of cementing its legacy forever.

The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company.

Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness.

products.title: Cocoon - Crystal Orb Light
products.body_html:
Cocoon is nothing short of a masterclass of game design, a mind-bending adventure set across worlds within worlds that challenges the player to think both laterally and creatively. Designer Jeppe Carlsen (lead gameplay designer of LIMBO & INSIDE) stretches the core mechanic of leaping from world to world to its absolute limits, crafting puzzles with sublime solutions that deftly run the gamut from “Ah Ha!” to “No Way?” to “Of Course!”, all while conveying a beautiful silent narrative and evoking visions of a techno-organic future that would make H.R. This 3” laser-etched crystal orb light, custom-built to match the game’s titular orbs, comes with its own activator pedestal with color-changing LED light. It’s the perfect fandom-flaunting piece to display on your desk or bookshelf.

products.title: Rare 40th Anniversary Box Set 4xLP
products.body_html:
Across its four decades of excellence, Rare has established itself as one of the most iconic names in video game development. Undercover shooters, merciless fighters, ursine platformers, swashbuckling treasure hunts…if you can dream it, Rare’s probably made it, with all the commitment to quality and whimsy that only a studio of their caliber could muster. 

Here at iam8bit, we stand in awe of their impressive pedigree. We’ve had the pleasure of working with our friends at Rare on several projects over the past several years, but we’re humbled to present this pièce de résistance, a true celebration of Rare and their impact on gaming as a hobby, an art form, and a world of endless possibilities.

This is the Rare 40th Anniversary Box Set 4xLP. Within its finely-constructed grooves, you’ll find an assortment of sweet-sounding tracks from a slew of incredible games. Ready to hear ‘em?! Sea of Thieves, Viva Piñata, Battletoads, Battletoads in Battlemaniacs, Banjo-Kazooie, Banjo-Tooie, Banjo-Kazooie Nuts & Bolts, Kinect Sports, Kinect Sports Season Two, Perfect Dark, Perfect Dark Zero, Killer Instinct, Killer Instinct Gold, Conker’s Bad Fur Day, Conker Live & Reloaded, Jet Force Gemini, Grabbed by the Ghoulies, Blast Corps, and Kameo: Elements of Power. WOW!

And those aforementioned grooves? They’re pressed on 4 Shades of Rareware Gold and Blue vinyl, a nod to the color of the legendary studio’s ever-evolving logo through the decades. It’s our way of calling back to those nostalgic boot-up screens we all remember so fondly. 

Now - Let’s talk album artwork, because this one’s a certified doozy. We collaborated with the amazing Lewy Jones to create a collage of Rare’s unforgettable heroes, villains, and goofballs, bursting with hidden secrets only the sharpest of eagle-eyed fans will be able to find. Likewise, each sleeve is adorned with a collage of Rare icons and legends, from talking piñatas to great and mighty poos and more. 

The whole package comes wrapped in a premium full-cover slipcase, ensuring it’ll all but demand to take center stage in your vinyl collection. 

This box set is a Rare delicacy, a true celebration of one of gaming’s most historically important studios. Treat yourself to this momentous musical legacy.

products.title: Psychonauts 2xLP (20th Anniversary Edition)
products.body_html:
Two decades ago, Double Fine’s seminal platforming collect-a-thon Psychonauts burst onto the scene in a whirlwind of trippy visuals, razor-sharp writing, and playful, energetic music. Games were never the same. 

Psychonauts is a wonderful pastiche of several disparate inspirations; its summer camp setting blends with mind-bending level design and superspy send–ups to create a wholly original, totally distinct flavor and tone you simply can’t find anywhere else. 

Its music, too, draws from a rich well of varied inspirations. Each level has its own aesthetic and feel, and Peter McConnell’s delightful soundtrack deftly dances from Spanish tangos to whimsical whistling to circus horns and beyond. 

Years ago, we at iam8bit teamed up with Double Fine to bring that soundtrack to vinyl for the very first time. Now, to celebrate Psychonauts’ impact on video games as a whole, we’re bringing that soundtrack back again — with, for the first time, a second disc. 

This is the Psychonauts 2xLP (20th Anniversary Edition)! We’ve repressed the original Psychonauts Soundtrack release, complete with album art from Lunar Saloon and a brand-new celebratory obi strip featuring art by our pal Ollie Hoff, to boot. Now, though, it comes on audiophile-approved Classic Black Vinyl, ensuring the best listening experience imaginable. 

And, as you can see, we’ve pulled out all the stops to celebrate two decades of Raz and pals. Disc 1 features the complete Psychonauts original soundtrack. That’s the iconic main theme, plus all those spicy themes from Psychonauts’ unforgettable mental worlds. It’s everything that was on the original Psychonauts Vinyl Soundtrack release. 

But we didn’t stop there. For the first time ever, the complete Psychonauts score is here on vinyl too, presented on a glorious second disc. It’s all the music from the game’s cutscenes, with a bonus medley of the themes to top it off. 

In short, it’s the total Psychonauts auditory experience, presented the way it was meant to be heard. It’s only fitting for a game with Psychonauts’ now-legendary legacy.

products.title: LIMBO 10” Vinyl
products.body_html:
15 years ago, visionary developer Playdead burst onto the indie game scene with the puzzle-platformer LIMBO. Wordless and monochromatic, LIMBO was more than just a mood piece; its thick atmosphere and perilous puzzles told a story of resilience and tenacity, even in the face of insurmountable fear.

Much of that atmosphere came from LIMBO’s now-legendary soundtrack. Ambient, experimental, and daring, the music of LIMBO left an indelible print on the landscape of video game music, and its impact can still be felt across the horror genre today. Despite its influence, LIMBO’s soundtrack has never been produced on vinyl. iam8bit is humbled by the honor of bringing this iconic soundtrack to the splendor of wax. 

This is the LIMBO 10” Vinyl, a true celebration of the game’s 15-year anniversary and its impact. It’s the complete soundtrack from maestro Martin Stig Andersen, pressed on classic black vinyl to ensure the utmost sound quality imaginable. 

For the album art, we worked with the Playdead team themselves to put together something special. Like the game itself, the jacket is bold, striking, and rendered in shades of black-and-white. Even the iam8bit & Playdead logos have been omitted from its printing, a rare break in our standards made to celebrate this monolith of a game. LIMBO deserves nothing less.

Unraveling generation-spanning mysteries is exhausting work. After a long day of cracking secretive ciphers and discovering cryptic clues, sometimes you just need to come back to the Mystery Shack, kick off your sleuthing shoes, and relax with some cool, cool beats. 

At iam8bit, we know how hard it is to be a gumptious gumshoe. That’s why we teamed up with our pals at Disney to bring this ultra-chill, ultra-catchy collection of tunes to your turntable. This is Lofi: Gravity Falls! 

Brian Parkhurst and Cooper Babbes lo-fi-ified the excellent original compositions from Brad Breeck, shapeshifting them into the perfect soundtrack for relaxing, studying, or even snoozing away the night. products.title: LEGO® Party! (PlayStation 5)
products.body_html:
LEGO® Party! is a 4-player party game that’s built different!

Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like LEGO Pirates, LEGO Space, LEGO NINJAGO® and more.

Join your friends online no matter their platform, or get together for a LEGO Party game night. With multiple game modes and tons of minifigures to unlock, you’ll have all the bricks to build the ultimate Party!

Challenge players near or far, customize your character and compete in a variety of awesome minigames to get as many Golden Bricks as you can, by any means necessary! But beware, watch out for monsters, traps and flying roast turkeys on your way to become the next star of LEGO Party!

 

Key Features:

Play your way: Bring your friends and enjoy the mayhem in couch multiplayer or with cross-platform online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Whether it's competing for the perfect score in Rocketball, practicing against that pesky kraken in Kraken Up or boogieing down in Dance Off, you can enjoy LEGO Party! together or solo!

 

Go for the gold: In LEGO Party! you have one goal: to become the player with the most Golden Bricks! Use power-ups to gain the advantage and set up traps to sabotage your opponents across a range of customizable LEGO themed Challenge Zones.

 

Everything is awesome: Put your speed, wits, and LEGO expertise to the test across a variety of crazy minigames. Race to make dinner for aliens, run through collapsing tombs and skid round the track in rally races and so much more across 60 different wildly fun minigames.

 

You do you: With over 1 billion minifigure combinations from iconic LEGO sets, you can go with a classic look or design your own unique and outlandish minifigure. Show off your creation at the next party!

products.title: LEGO® Party! (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
LEGO® Party! is a 4-player party game that’s built different!

Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like LEGO Pirates, LEGO Space, LEGO NINJAGO® and more.

Join your friends online no matter their platform, or get together for a LEGO Party game night. With multiple game modes and tons of minifigures to unlock, you’ll have all the bricks to build the ultimate Party!

Challenge players near or far, customize your character and compete in a variety of awesome minigames to get as many Golden Bricks as you can, by any means necessary! But beware, watch out for monsters, traps and flying roast turkeys on your way to become the next star of LEGO Party!

 

Key Features:

Play your way: Bring your friends and enjoy the mayhem in couch multiplayer or with cross-platform online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Whether it's competing for the perfect score in Rocketball, practicing against that pesky kraken in Kraken Up or boogieing down in Dance Off, you can enjoy LEGO Party! together or solo!

 

Go for the gold: In LEGO Party! you have one goal: to become the player with the most Golden Bricks! Use power-ups to gain the advantage and set up traps to sabotage your opponents across a range of customizable LEGO themed Challenge Zones.

 

Everything is awesome: Put your speed, wits, and LEGO expertise to the test across a variety of crazy minigames. Race to make dinner for aliens, run through collapsing tombs and skid round the track in rally races and so much more across 60 different wildly fun minigames.

 

You do you: With over 1 billion minifigure combinations from iconic LEGO sets, you can go with a classic look or design your own unique and outlandish minifigure. Show off your creation at the next party!

products.title: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo™ 2xLP
products.body_html:
The top-down 2D platformer Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo™ sees its plucky protagonist navigating a dense and lively urban landscape with the aid of — what else? — his trusty yoyo. As Pippit masters new tricks, each one more electric than the last, new areas of the game’s massive map start to open up, unveiling juicy secrets along the way.

It’s a kinetic, lively approach to the Metroidvania sub-genre, one that demands a kinetic, lively soundtrack to match. Pipistrello maestros Leonardo Lima and Henrique Lorenzi delivered on that notion and what’s more, one of gaming’s great icons, the legendary Yoko Shimomura, contributed her timeless talents to the game’s score with the baroquely beautiful track “Pipistrello Manor.”

The result? Haughty digitized harpsichords blend with funky and fresh drum beats to create a smoothie of oh-so-delicious sounds. iam8bit is proud to partner with our friends at Pocket Trap™ and PM Studios™ to bring it to you, on wax. 

This is the Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo 2xLP! Its two discs, pressed on Pippit Blue and Madame Magenta, are packed with the very best of Pipistrello’s soundtrack. For the album art, iam8bit bestie Ollie Hoff put together a killer design featuring illustrations from Rodrigo Zangelmi and Hendric Sueitt, fitting for the game’s vibrant, eye-catching style.

Grab your yoyo and get ready to hit the streets: The Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo 2xLP has arrived!

products.title: Steven Universe: Volume 2 - 2x10” Vinyl
products.body_html:
In many ways, the fifth and final regular season of Steven Universe was a departure from the rest of the series. Having established its deep mythos and lovable cast of rich characters, the show shifted to explore hidden corners of its world and revealed gasp-inducing new discoveries. Still, its central theme remained constant: Never stop fighting for compassion, understanding, forgiveness, and love. 

Music, too, remained central to Steven Universe. Series creator Rebecca Sugar teamed up once again with Aivi & Surasshu, Ben Levin, and Jeff Liu to create an assortment of certified classics, performed by the show’s beloved cast. All-new tracks like “Ruby Rider” and “That Distant Shore” gave fan-favorite characters a chance to shine, while playful reprisals like “Let Me Ska My Van Into Your Heart” and “We Are The Crystal Gems (Change Your Mind Version)” put new twists on old hits. 

We at iam8bit adored the music of season five, and we, like many of you, desperately wanted it on vinyl. So we joined forces with our friends at WaterTower Music to make it happen. 

Say hello to the Steven Universe: Volume 2, 2x10” Vinyl set! We worked hard to produce a set that complements our 4x10” version of Volume 1, as well as our 4x10” set for the Movie. As you can see, the stunning album art from Steven Universe Art Director Jasmin Lai parallels the Volume 1 illustrations, ensuring all three sets simply stun while sitting together on your shelf. 

Volume 2’s discs are pressed on Blue Diamond and Yellow Diamond vinyl, complete with gorgeous diamond center labels that pair oh-so-nicely with Volume 1’s gem set. They contain 11 tracks from season five, plus the Reprisal of Love Like You, the show’s iconic end credits theme. 

The wait is over: the Steven Universe: Volume 2-  2x10” Vinyl is here. 

 

 

 

™ & © 2017 Cartoon Network

products.title: Another Crab’s Treasure Tote Bag
products.body_html:
Another Crab’s Treasure is more than just a cheeky soulslike — the cleverly-penned, pun-filled indie tells an eco-friendly tale of preservation and perseverance, subtly drawing parallels between Kril’s personal quest and the global struggle against pollution. Put another way, Aggro Crab’s adventure features the kind of well-considered storytelling that would make Fern Gully blush. 

We at iam8bit found Another Crab’s Treasure to be nothing short of galvanizing, and so, naturally, we jumped at the chance to team up with the fine folks at Aggro Crab. We wanted to carry on that spirit of environmentalism in our product offering; plus, we found would-be hero Kril too cute, and all but demanded the chance to get his face on some goodies. 

Thus, the Another Crab’s Treasure Tote Bag was born. It’s made of eco-friendly 100% recycled materials and features adorable art of Kril by our friend cobcris. What’s more, we’re donating $1 from every sale to environmental charity Sustainable Coastlines. You’ll get a Certificate of Donation with your purchase to make the whole thing mega official. 

We hope that wherever you take this tenacious little tote — the beach, the farmer’s market, the aquarium — you carry it with a memory of your little crustacean pal and his quest to win back his home.

products.title: Another Crab’s Treasure 2xLP
products.body_html:
What sort of life is brimming under the sea? 

According to Aggro Crab’s smash hit, Another Crab’s Treasure, the answer’s all manner of colorful, kooky characters — most notably, a cantankerous, tax-evading hermit crab by the name of Kril. His quest to reacquire his beloved shell forms the basis for the vibrant Soulslike adventure, which soon develops into a story packed with new friendships, sinister conspiracies, and unexpected eco-friendly themes. 

Like the ocean itself, it’s a lively, varied biosphere of inspirations, all coming together to form one big, beautiful thing — and so is the game’s music, finely crafted by the talented Feasley. Playful and energetic but still unafraid to get weird, Another Crab’s Treasure boasts a soundtrack filled with memorable motifs and bubbly beats. We at iam8bit are proud to present it to you here on vinyl. 

Get ready to dive into Another Crab’s Treasure 2xLP, a two disc set featuring the complete original soundtrack in all its salty glory. In keeping with the game’s message of environmentalism, we’ve pressed it on Random Eco Blend Color Vinyl. That means it’s made of 100% recycled, carbon neutral material, available in one of six randomly-selected shades per disc, and no two discs will look exactly the same. 

For the album art, we tapped our friend cobcris to craft a summery scene of adorable wanderlust featuring our plucky protagonist Kril. And check out that inner sleeve — it’s quite simply too cute for words.

We think it’s a shell of an album, and we humbly hope you do, too. 

 

 

 

©2024 Aggro Crab Games

products.title: Plants Vs. Zombies: Bad Zombies 7"
products.body_html:
Plants vs. Zombies, with its easy-to-understand gameplay and whimsically morbid aesthetic, has cemented itself as a cultural icon.

Its popularity, naturally, has led to a fair share of memes, riffs, salutes, and celebrations, including a now-iconic musical motif from one of today’s premier popstars. Billie Eilish’s “Bad Guy” features a groovy baseline that plays off the main theme from Plants vs. Zombies; a fitting match, given the track’s eerie playfulness, a spirit well alive in PvZ. 

Here at iam8bit, we love a great tribute. Even more, we love a tribute-tag-back, where the respect for great artists flows in a fully-formed circle. It makes us feel all warm and fuzzy inside. So, when we teamed up with the incredible folks at PopCap Games and EA Games for our Plants vs. Zombies 2xLP, a brainy idea emerged: Why not release a new single that nods to Billie’s iconic song?

This is the Plants vs. Zombies: Bad Zombies 7”. It features a brand-new, never-before-heard single performed by The String Revolution featuring Tina Guo, aptly titled “Bad Zombies.” You’ve got to hear it. 

For something so amazing, we had to go all out. That’s why it comes pressed on Eco-Purple vinyl and features a special zoetrope center label that all but comes alive while it spins. That eco-friendly vinyl is all recycled, so it’s good for the plants. It also means that there will be some very groovy variation for every disc; no two colors will be completely the same. 

For the album art, we worked with Sean Keeton to pay homage to the cover of Billie’s “When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go?” And to ensure it’s got that signature PvZ flare, it even glows in the dark! 

Folks, this one’s special. Don’t miss it.

products.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2xLP
products.body_html:
Plants vs. Zombies is the very definition of “lightning in a bottle.” Simple to understand but challenging to beat, the game brought a genre typically reserved for only the brainiest of tacticians to the most main that mainstream can get. 

On its way to superstardom, PvZ reaped its fair share of accolades, awards, and loads of other laudings. Developer PopCap Games, designer George Fan, and publisher EA Games spun straw into gold with their tower defense title, building a multimedia franchise brick by brick in the process. 

Equal parts creepy and playful, the game’s music somehow struck the same whimsical balance as PvZ’s macabre-but-mischevous theming, drawing sounds from marching band music, swing, techno, and more. 

It’s both inspired and inspiring, and we at iam8bit are happily inspired to bring it to vinyl for the first time ever. This is the Plants vs. Zombies 2xLP. 

Inside its premium packaging, you’ll find two discs (on warfaring Zombie Purple and Plant Green vinyl, of course!), packed with the very best of Laura Shigihara’s now iconic score. All the hits are here — even “Zombies on Your Lawn.” 

As for that premium packaging, it’s a sight to behold. Soft sculpture artist Modest Monster fabricated (get it?) a felt-fueled scene of intense garden combat and photographed it to perfection; all the models featured on this record are real figures, no rendering required. It’s a fitting tribute to one of gaming’s most beloved titles.

products.title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings™ Game (PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
The beauty of the Shire and the Hobbits who live in this peaceful corner of Middle-earth represent the perfect setting for the ever-popular cosy game genre.

J.R.R. Tolkien’s halflings lead a life filled with tranquility, which, especially in our hectic modern times, is an appealing fantasy in and of itself. The folks at Wētā Workshop (and their friends at publisher Private Division) recognized the warm appeal of a Hobbit’s life, and thus Tales of The Shire was born.

We at iam8bit love to daydream about living in a Hobbit home, with days spent tending the land and nights filled with the comforts of home-cooked meals and hot cups of tea. That’s why we teamed up with Wētā Workshop to bring you this one-of-a-kind creation.

Presenting the Tales of the Shire Exclusive Edition, a celebration of all things cosy. You’ll get the game on disc/cart, region-free as always, with an idyllic cover sheet that captures the spirit of community and friendship only found in Bywater.

That’s not all; to fully transport you* to the world of Middle-earth, we’ve included a beautiful 20”x16” fold-out map for the quaint village of Bywater.

It’s a perfect pastoral vacation, squeezed down into a game box and packaged with all the love and care only iam8bit can provide.

Welcome home, Hobbits!

products.title: Cuphead 4xLP Deluxe Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
iam8bit is proud to collaborate with Studio MDHR and Kristofer Maddigan to bring you this period-specific thrill ride of jazz jollies and big band boisterousness - an outrageously rare treat comprised of four jam-packed records featuring some of the coolest and smoothest tunes you’ve ever grooved along to.

This is a spectacular sensation of a vinyl set, composed of so much delicious, fully-orchestral decadence that we couldn’t resist creating a ridiculously complex custom companion package, stripped straight from the 1930s. Designer Jango Snow spared no detail in collaborating with the maniacally brilliant Studio MDHR to create this beautiful folio design, affectionately inspired by record sets almost a century old.

What you’re seeing here is top-tier, first-class elegance, drenched in passion and oozing with embellishments like gold foil and embossments galore.

Holding the Cuphead 4xLP Deluxe Vinyl Soundtrack makes us smile big. It’s a damn fantastic edition and we think it’ll make you smile too.

products.title: Sunset Riders 10” Vinyl Reissue
products.body_html:
Years ago, iam8bit and Konami joined forces to create the Sunset Riders 10” Vinyl Soundtrack. Like the arcade hit itself, it was an instant cult classic; 24 tracks of 16-bit Wild West chiptune beats by the wizards at KONAMI KUKEIHA CLUB, mastered especially for vinyl on a “clear smoke” 10 inch LP. The release became an important moment in iam8bit history, and consequently, the history of video game vinyl as a whole. 

Now, Steve, Billy Cool, Bob, and Cormano Wild are ready to ride once again. This is the Sunset Riders 10” Vinyl Soundtrack, reissued and freshly pressed on Orange Crush vinyl. All 24 tracks are here again, in all their glory. Plus, we’ve updated the original pixel-powered album art from Drew Wise, presenting it on a fresh die cut bullet hole-riddled jacket. It’s all part of the iam8bit 20th Anniversary Collection.

products.title: iam8bit x Mark Borgions - 20th Anniversary Shirt
products.body_html:
2 decades! Over 300 albums released! Over 3 million records pressed!

However you slice it, 20 years is a long time, and it marks a milestone worth celebrating for iam8bit. From our humble beginnings planning nerd-tastic art shows in Los Angeles to pioneering the boom of video game vinyl and beyond, there are so many moments in our history we look back upon with nostalgia. 

But our greatest achievements — the ones that give us the cuddliest of fuzzies — lie in the memories we’ve helped to create for you, the fans. Whether you’re sharing your favorite soundtrack with a loved one or taking a quiet, meditative spin in the comfort of your home, the transformative power of music is altogether singular and indescribably magnificent. 

That’s the spirit we wanted to capture with this, the iam8bit x Mark Borgions - 20th Anniversary Shirt — the sheer, unabashed joy that comes with listening to the warm & welcoming sounds of your favorite vinyl. Then, we screen printed that design on to heavyweight eco-friendly 100% combed cotton — because comfort is, after all, king. 

Here’s to 20 years, and here’s to 20 more. 

Part of the iam8bit 20th Anniversary Lifestyle Collection.

products.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio 4xLP Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
Metaphor: ReFantazio presents a vision unlike any other title in the Atlus oeuvre. Its politically-charged high-fantasy narrative boldly explores timely themes of unrest, anxiety, equality, and utopia. Coupled with a refined take on the studio’s signature JRPG gameplay, as well as an enrapturing painterly visual style, it's no wonder Metaphor earned Game of the Year awards from several publications. 

It’s a bold, unique game, with a bold, unique soundtrack that pulls from a global palette of auditory inspirations, including lyrics in a fictional language and chanted beautifully by a Buddhist Monk. It is, in a word, unforgettable. We at iam8bit knew it deserved an unforgettable vinyl treatment to match. 

Introducing the Metaphor: ReFantazio 4xLP Vinyl Soundtrack. We worked with Atlus Sound Team to hand-select the perfect arrangement of songs from their breathtaking score, mastering them especially for vinyl. For the discs, we crafted a character-inspired vinyl treatment, each one with its own color to represent the heroes at the heart of Metaphor’s charming cast. 

For the album artwork, we teamed up with longtime iam8bit artisan, Drew Wise, to create not just packaging, but a full-on Metaphor-inspired experience. The outer box features gold embossments and a leatherbound-style look, drawing from the storybook motif in the game. We extended this concept to the parchment-esque inner sleeves. 

The result is a veritable centerpiece to any vinyl collection, a one-of-a-kind package that celebrates one of the very best roleplaying games of all time.

products.title: Persona 3 Reload: Episode Aigis -The Answer- 2xLP
products.body_html:
Persona 3 Reload: Episode Aigis -The Answer-, like its forefather Persona 3 FES, places a coda on the base game’s narrative while remixing and reimagining its core mechanics. Persona 3 deuteragonist Aigis takes the center stage and brings with her a fresh perspective on the game’s compelling combat, world, and aesthetic. 

And of course, in true Persona fashion, the soundtrack for Episode Aigis features both remixes from Persona 3 and brand-new classics from the legendary Atlus Sound Team alike. Make no mistake; this soundtrack is an important part of the overall Persona canon, and we at iam8bit knew it demanded the full vinyl treatment. 

The Persona 3 Reload: Episode Aigis -The Answer- 2xLP is packed with banger after banger from the DLC. We’ve pressed it on two dual-colored split discs; one light yellow and clear, and the other red and black. To celebrate the relationship at the core of Episode Aigis, we’ve dubbed this colorway Aigis and Metis Vinyl. 

Plus, we tapped Persona series stalwart Drew Wise to craft the gorgeous cover art, designed to — what else? — remix and reimagine the cover for our Persona 3 Reload vinyl. Don’t miss your chance to take this one home. 

 


©Atlus. Ⓟ©Sega. All Rights Reserved.

products.title: Persona 4 Megamix Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
Widely regarded as one of the greatest video game soundtracks of all time, Persona 4’s music is strikingly upbeat, consistently drenching the listener in “retro pop” feels. It’s the kind of magical listening experience that can seamlessly loop in the background for eternity and never lose a bit of its shine.

We at iam8bit teamed up with Atlus Sound Team to curate this excellent cutdown of that legendary OST. This is the Persona 4 Megamix Vinyl Soundtrack, pressed on Clear with Yellow and Black Splatter Vinyl.

In addition to crafting a stellar tracklist of the very best Persona 4 songs, we worked with longtime iam8bit superpal Drew Wise to reimagine the original album art for this special Megamix edition. The narrative device of dimension-rifting through TVs is lovingly translated to this spectacular packaging design. Just try not to get trapped on the other side for too long…

 


©Atlus. ©Sega. All Rights Reserved.

products.title: Persona 3 Reload Megamix Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
The Persona 3 Reload soundtrack pays tribute to the distinctive late-2000s style of the original game while still providing a decidedly modern sound. 

At the same time, that unmistakable Persona swagger is still there by the bucketful, as Atlus Sound Team deftly weaves across genres and influences spanning opera, hip-hop, house, and more. 

This is the Persona 3 Reload Megamix, a sleek ‘n’ stylish cutdown record on Clear with Blue Splatter Vinyl. We at iam8bit worked with Atlus Sound Team to select fan-favorite tracks from the game, curating and cultivating an absolutely exquisite listening experience. 

Plus, we’ve tweaked the original album art from our friend Drew Wise to create the perfect package that brings it all together. You’re gonna love every single spin.

products.title: Steven Universe: The Movie 4x10” Vinyl Set
products.body_html:
From breezy ukelele ditties to big-band dance numbers, music has always been core to Steven Universe. 

Steven Universe: The Movie is no exception, with original music produced by series mainstays aivi & surasshu and a host of new songs performed by the film’s cast, written by Rebecca Sugar in collaboration with Chance The Rapper, James Fauntleroy, Ted Leo, Mike Krol, and more.

The music of Steven Universe: The Movie made an incredible impact on the fandom and practically demanded a vinyl release to match its legacy. Originally issued in 12” vinyl in both standard and deluxe formats, the album quickly became a hard-to-find fan favorite.

Now, iam8bit is teaming up with WaterTower Music to reissue this incredible piece of animation history. Say hello to the Steven Universe: The Movie 4x10” Vinyl Set, a reformatted release of the motion picture soundtrack, tailor-made to mirror the Steven Universe 4x10” Vinyl Set.

In addition to reformatting the original 12” deluxe release to 10” discs on Spinel Black Ice, Grape, Milky Clear, and Ruby vinyl, we took the excellent album art from the first release and embellished it with additional embossments and foiling, crafted to match the shine of the series’ 10” vinyl release.

The result is a total reimagining of the original release, built from the ground-up to complement the series’ 10” set. It’s truly worth its weight in gems.

products.title: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit (Xbox Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
We at iam8bit don’t need to tell you what you already know: The extended world of Five Nights at Freddy’s has taken on an animatronic-esque life of its own, expanding into realms spanning feature films, metafiction, and beyond. And why not? The series’ fandom is downright voracious, consuming every bit of tantalizing lore available, wherever it can be found. 

Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit represents a rich vein of that delicious mythology. Based on the novel of the same name, it leaps into the past —literally, by way of the titular ball pit  — to tell an original narrative with all the thrills and chills you might expect from the series. 

The team at Mega Cat Studios worked hard to ensure every element of Into the Pit worked harmoniously with that “throwback” theme. Packed with lovingly-crafted pixel art and old-school adventure game puzzles, Into the Pit is truly a modern classic, and a gem of a beloved genre of yesteryear. Consider this physical edition a humble polishing of that gem. 

This is the Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit Exclusive Edition. In addition to the game itself, on glorious physical media, you’ll get a 12"x18" Glow in the Dark Fold-Out Poster, not available anywhere else. Give your room that animatronic ambiance you’ve always wanted. Plus, you’ll get a set of 3 Sticker Sheets, perfect for decorating your water bottle, notebook, or anywhere else that needs a bit of spine-tingling style. 

Do you dare descend into the pit? We’re waiting for you…

products.title: One Piece (Soundtrack from the Netflix Series) Essential Edition 2xLP
products.body_html:
Ahoy, Straw Hat Crew!  

One Piece is a bona-fide global phenomenon, and our friends at Netflix gave Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates new life through a faithful reimagining of the iconic manga, born again for a new generation, via their critically acclaimed live-action series. With lively visuals, lovely-world building, and unforgettably nautical music, One Piece captivates lifelong fans and brand-new landlubbers alike. 

This is the One Piece 2xLP, an absolutely epic vinyl release to match the seafaring fantasy from which it was born.

This truly is a superbly unique release, a perfect compliment to the orchestral adventure of the music. Composers Sonya Belousova and Giona Ostinelli put together a swashbuckling score that sounds all-the-more lively on wax, and complements the larger-than-life visuals of the show, as it whirlpools on your turntable.

As such, we at iam8bit felt it was of the utmost importance to get this rad-as-heck record into as many pirate palms as possible. products.title: The Cuphead Show! 2xLP
products.body_html:
The Cuphead Show! is more than just an adaptation of Studio MDHR’s bombastic hit video game shoot-’em-up: Both a reverent homage to early American animation and an irreverent musical slapstick romp, the show carved out a unique aesthetic identity of its very own. 

Ego Plum’s playful, lively soundtrack plays a massive role in establishing that identity. Calling to mind inspirations ranging from ‘30s vaudeville to the golden age of ‘90s animation, The Cuphead Show’s music is packed with enough personality to match the show’s charming cast of characters. Speaking of characters - they sing, too, including a super catchy theme song that’ll put your gramophone in the best of moods.

We at iam8bit just can’t get enough Cuphead, Mugman, and Ms. Chalice in our lives, so we teamed up with our pals at Netflix to bring you this: The Cuphead Show! 2xLP, two high-quality 180 gram black vinyl discs filled to the brim with the show’s energetic music. 

For the album art, we worked with the show’s creator, executive producer (and sometimes song writer), Dave Wasson, to craft designs that thread the needle between “classic throwback” and “modern maverick” just as deftly as the show itself. The whole gang's here, from Cuphead and his pals to Elder Kettle and even the Devil himself, on one of the inner sleeves. Plus, to make the package all-the-sweeter, we’ve included a bonus collectible postcard featuring original illustrations you won’t find anywhere else. 

Get ready for adventure. The Cuphead Show! 2xLP is here.

products.title: Diablo IV 4xLP
products.body_html:
Time and time again, the Diablo franchise has both defined and redefined the gold standard for the action RPG genre, and the fourth installment is no exception. In Diablo IV, Blizzard Entertainment blended the series’ signature dungeon-crawling with open-world, play-as-you-will exploration and densely tactical PVP skirmishes to create an experience that is both strikingly iconic and wholly new. 

That innovative gameplay sings even sweeter against the game’s grimly dark backdrop. Dripping with demonic, transgressive style, the look and feel of Diablo IV is unlike anything else in games. 

But it’s not just about the compelling visuals — hell has never sounded sweeter, too. Composers Leo Kaliski, Ted Reedy, Ryan Amon and Derek Duke saw to that, crafting an epic soundscape that’s one part Mephestophilan and one part Medieval. We at iam8bit felt it was fiendishly important to capture that mood for your turntable. 

This is the Diablo IV 4xLP, four infernal discs jam-packed with the music of Blizzard Entertainment’s hack-and-slash masterwork. We’ve styled the vinyl treatment to pay homage to some of the game’s iconic classes, and named each color after classic moves: Grizzly Rage Gold, Grim Harvest Green, Frost Nova Blue, & Rapture Red. 

Plus, we tapped the talented Ryan Brinkerhoff to craft album art in-line with that celebration of Diablo IV’s fighters. Each sleeve is a tribute to a different class’s strength and iconography. The whole thing comes together with outer album art that would make Lilith herself blush.

As an extra-special treat, we’re also including a code for an in-game Mount Trophy in DiabloⓇ  IV, usable by all classes.  Getting around Sanctuary’s no easy task, but it’s a hell of a lot better when you’re looking your best — and nothing’s swankier than a precious ornament for your ride. Whether you’re playing co-op with a friend or fighting online foes, you’ll be able to show off your devotion in style. Claim your code on Battle.net to unlock it in-game on all platforms.

There’s nothing Faustian about this bargain. The Diablo IV 4xLP simply needs to be a part of your collection.

Note: The download code for the in-game Mount Trophy will be included with the record, and will ship inside the record’s packaging.

products.title: Alien: Isolation Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
In a world filled with quick cash-in licensed games, Alien: Isolation was a gasp of fresh air. Its release in 2014 marked a watershed moment for what inspired and faithful adaptations could look like in video games as a medium. 

With its retro-futuristic visuals, subtly haunting sound design, nail-bitingly tense gameplay, and brilliantly ahead-of-its-time AI, Creative Assembly’s masterwork presented a different sort of vent-crawling survival horror, one well-suited for the world of Weyland-Yutani. 

Now, a decade later, we at iam8bit are proud to celebrate Alien: Isolation’s 10th anniversary by offering fans something never before available: The game’s legendary soundtrack, presented on high-quality vinyl. This is the Alien: Isolation Vinyl Soundtrack, a 1xLP loaded up with the very best songs from composers The Flight and Christian Henson’s famous score, pressed on Blood Green vinyl.

Keeping in line with the game’s grimy, lo-fi art design, the music of Isolation is a journey through tense corporate steel, dripping with an unforgiving atmosphere that often transports the listener right into the cold, unending expanse of outer space. It’s not all doom and gloom, though — like Amanda Ripley herself, Isolation’s music buoys forward through sheer will and unexpected moments of warm hope. 

For the artwork, we tapped longtime iam8bit friend Nimit Malavia to craft a piece that captures the vast, unending terror of Alien’s world; not just terror in the wake of an unspeakable monstrosity, but terror in the realization that we are cosmically alone. 

Because, after all: In space, no one can hear you scream. 

 

 

 

 

© 20th Century Studios

products.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender (Soundtrack from the Netflix Series) 2xLP
products.body_html:
“Water. Earth. Fire. Air. Long ago, the four nations lived together in harmony…”

In 2024, Netflix breathed new life into the rich world of Avatar: The Last Airbender with a legendary live-action adaptation. This reimagining added new snippets of lore and gave longtime fans a more visceral perspective on the mystical art of element bending. This experience was made all the more immersive thanks to the series’ stunning score. 

Composer Takeshi Furukawa (The Last Guardian) turned in an epic orchestral accompaniment to Aang’s emotional world-spanning journey. From subtle woodwind sounds to pit-a-patting drumbeats, the music of Avatar confidently calls to mind fantasy fables of yore. 

Now you can relive that auditory journey again and again through the magic of your turntable. This is the Avatar: The Last Airbender 2xLP, the complete soundtrack for Season 1 of Netflix’s adventure series. It’s pressed on stunning Four Elements Colored vinyl, to ensure the sight of it spinning is just as enrapturing as the sound. 

Such incredible music deserves epic packaging to match, so in true iam8bit form, we spared no ounce of ingenuity to create a first-of-its-kind jacket. Paying homage to the series’ theme of unification and harmony, we tapped artist Andy Fairhurst to paint a bespoke experience featuring the four iconic elements, converging together to bring peace to a world drenched in turmoil. This “convergence” of elements, created by way of an innovative and intricately folding origami jacket, must be seen to be believed.

Long live the Avatar, now immortalized on vinyl.

products.title: Persona Q: Shadow of the Labyrinth 4xLP
products.body_html:
What happens when you meld the elegant combat of the Persona series with the meticulous dungeon mapping of Etrian Odyssey? You get Persona Q, a certified banger of a spin-off from the Atlus team packed with enough style and substance to make the 3DS burst. 


But make no mistake: Despite being on a more diminutive system than some of its older cousins, Persona Q lacks none of the punch, panache, and pizazz the series is known for. That’s doubly true for the electrifying music. 


For Persona Q, the Atlus Sound Team created a unique soundtrack that still lives firmly in the world of the Persona series. Q explores a gentler soundscape, fitting for the game’s more deliberate, dungeon-crawling gameplay. It’s wonderful stuff, and we at iam8bit are pleased as punch to bring it to you here.


This is the Persona Q 4xLP, and it is positively loaded with the very best tracks from the game. Pressed on high-quality Multicolor vinyl, each disc has been mastered to ensure an optimal listening experience, every single spin. 


Plus, it wouldn’t be an iam8bit x Persona release without next level album art. We tapped stalwart and talented Persona design alum, Drew Wise, to pretty up this premium collector's box, housing the gorgeous 4-disc set.


Dungeon crawling has never sounded so good.

products.title: Persona 4 Arena & Persona 4 Arena Ultimax 3xLP
products.body_html:
In Persona 4 Arena, Persona 4’s Investigation Team clashes with the Shadow Operatives of Persona 3 in stylish, combo-driven 1-on-1 battles, broken up by visual novel cutscenes that tell an all-new, original, canonical story set in the Persona universe. 

Created in a partnership between Atlus and Arc System Works, the original 2D fighter was unlike anything the series had ever seen, and it was an instant fan favorite. It’s no wonder, then, that a sequel soon followed. 

Persona 4 Arena Ultimax both refined the gameplay of the first Arena and wrapped up its story with two unique campaigns, split between the Persona 3 and Persona 4 cast. Packed with tons of additional content, online play, a survival mode, and more, Persona 4 Arena Ulitmax was more fighting game goodness in every single way. 


Just as Arena remixed the gameplay of Persona, so too did its music take familiar motifs and themes from the series and paint them in an all-new light. Atlus Sound Team packed both titles’ soundtracks with original songs, fresh remixes, and fan-favorite bangers perfect for battling the night away. 

We at iam8bit love a great combo. That’s why we’re proud to bring you this, the P4A & P4AU 3xLP. It’s the very best of Persona 4 Arena and Persona 4 Arena Ultimax’s music, pressed on splatter vinyl across two gorgeous discs. 

Plus, we teamed up with Persona pal, Drew Wise, to craft all-new, drool-worthy album art, the perfect complement to the stylish 2D fighter and the latest must-have for your record shelf. 

Get ready to fight in style. The P4A & P4AU 3xLP is here.

products.title: Lies of P 3xLP
products.body_html:
A compelling soulslike draped in the trappings of a dark, twisted fairy tale, Lies of P has cemented itself as a favorite among action-rpg connoisseurs, garnering all kinds of nominations and awards along the way. The little games we made up as kids to while away the hours were nothing short of miraculous…and for those still in touch with that sense of childhood whimsy, they make for pretty phenomenal video game inspiration, too.

products.title: Simpler Times 2xLP

Simpler Times is Available Now on Steam

As you paint, take pictures, read notes, and solve puzzles across Simpler Times’ four seasons, music envelopes your experience. Musician George Pandrea produced a wholly original soundtrack for the game, packed with low-fi beats, chill vocals, and warm, hypnotic loops, all in service of crafting an auditory journey that feels like a cool summer breeze, dancing through your bedroom window. 


Art, music, and vinyl are so fundamental to the experience of Simpler Times that we at iam8bit had to capture this beautiful alchemy on wax.

What’s better than a cool breeze and a chill beat? Spin up this record and let yourself feel true bliss.

products.title: Oxenfree II: Lost Signals 2xLP

products.title: Cocoon (iam8bit Collector’s Edition)

products.title: Frog Detective Vinyl Soundtrack

products.title: Trombone Champ Vinyl Soundtrack

The Trombone Champ Vinyl Soundtrack is a 1xLP packed full of sweet, sweet brass-powered tunes, selected and performed (excellently, by the way — no flubbed notes here) by the Holy Wow team themselves. products.title: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe (iam8bit Collector's Edition)
products.body_html:
Stanley clicked the link. As a long time appreciator of fine, premium tangible goods, he was a frequent visitor of the iam8bit web store. He loved to soak in all of the clever details of their collector’s editions, vinyl, and more, and, level-headed as he was, he never Tweeted impatiently at them regarding preorder wait times. 

On that day, one particular item caught his eye: It was The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe Collector’s Edition. Stanley had an interest in innovative, cleverly-penned indie games, especially when they playfully merged meta-commentary and ludological twists to build out whip-smart satire on interactive entertainment. 

As a result, he was a big fan of developer Crows Crows Crows’ The Stanley Parable, and the Ultra Deluxe edition, with its additive content and unexpected updates, was in particular his favorite version of the game. And this Collector’s Edition seemed like a true celebration of The Stanley Parable’s massive impact on the art form. 

Within its premium, delectable box was a world of extra goodies: First off, the game cover itself featured original exclusive cover art by Fatih Oztürk. What’s more, there was a The Stanley Parable: Reassurance Bucket Manual hiding inside, providing Stanley Parable-style instructions on how the purchaser could build their very own commemorative The Stanley Parable Collectible Bucket, using only a common bucket and the (also included) Official Stanley Parable Ultra Deluxe Merchandise Sticker. How innovative!  

And – what was this? – why, a figure of Stanley himself! How deliciously meta of the Collector’s Edition creators to include a 5” PVC Stanley figurine (also called Figleys, Stanlurines, Mini-Stans, Stanley-Figs, Figlureanlurines, Figanleys, Stiggley-Wiggleys). He couldn’t wait to unpack it and put it on his desk, so he could smile benignly at it and think back on all the fond memories he had built over the years, sitting at his desk. 

But what would Stanley listen to, there at that self same desk? Perhaps a digital edition of The Stanley Parable soundtrack, using the code included with this Collector’s Edition! It really did have everything. 

Yes, indeed: It was an honor for Stanley to be a small part of this monumental partnership between iam8bit and developer Crows Crows Crows, playing the role that he knew the very best: The Consumer.

products.title: Vampire Survivors Vol. 1 - 2xLP
products.body_html:
No one was prepared for Vampire Survivors to come crashing into the indie game scene the way it did. Poncle’s debut title combined slick, roguelike bullet-hell gameplay with a cheeky-but-undeniably-rad gothic aesthetic to craft a brew that players found impossible to put down. Since the game’s debut, countless mortal hours have been spent firing all manner of projectiles at all manner of undead beings in graveyards, haunted mansions, mad forests and beyond. And each of those hours have been made all the richer thanks to Vampire Survivor’s incredible soundtrack. 

Part-sendup, part-tribute, but still wholly original, Survivor’s synthy soundtrack, crafted by the superduo of Daniele Zandara and Will Davies, harkens back to vampire-slaying franchises of yore. But it does so in a decidedly modern soundscape, exploring things that were impossible on old soundchips. The resulting music is epic, nostalgic, and unexpected, packed with rad riffs and high-impact drum fills alike. 

iam8bit loves to live at the intersection of nostalgia and new-wave (not to mention the intersection of sendup and sincerity), so we were champing at the neck bit to bring you this record. This is the Vampire Survivors Vol.1 2xLP, a slayer’s bounty of your favorite ditties, themes, and tracks from Poncle’s beloved bullet hell beauty. In keeping with the theme and aesthetic, we’ve pressed these songs on crimson-tinged Blood Splatter Red Vinyl.

Plus: The cover art, which speaks for itself has Illustrator Nimit Malavia perfectly capturing the mood of Vampire Survivors with a piece so bodacious and badass, your middle school trapper keeper doodles could only dream of being as cool. 

This all comes together to create a radical, undead-slaying, garlic-chomping masterpiece of a vinyl release.

products.title: Bee and PuppyCat 2xLP
products.body_html:
Let’s face it: Your early twenties can be pretty tough. Meeting new people, carving out your place in the world, and somehow finding the time to make rent in between is challenging stuff. It’s helpful to have a grumpy little space-faring best friend by your side, someone to guide you through your intergalactic oddjob adventures — or to just be a pal who can share a snack with you on the couch after a long, long day. 

That’s the heart of Natasha Allegri’s creative, cute and cordial animated adventure, Bee and PuppyCat. Our titular heroine and her adorable feline-canine hybrid embark on all sorts of misadventures through the mysterious Fishbowl Space, meeting a cast of quirky, sincerely sketched characters along the way. Through this heartwarming and unabashed weirdness, the show at once defies explanation and feels entirely cozy and familiar, like a long-lost childhood friend. 

The show’s surreal electronic soundtrack lives in that space, too. Packed with bite-sized themes and mischievous little loops, artist Will Wiesenfeld (of Baths) has crafted a luscious soundscape that feels like a digitized warm summer breeze. 

We at iam8bit are proud to partner with our friends at Milan and Frederator Studios to bring this soundscape to you, for the first time, on vinyl. This is the Bee and PuppyCat 2xLP, 4 whopping sides of sweet, sweet selections from Volume 1 and Volume 2 of the Bee and PuppyCat (Original Netflix Series) soundtrack. 

And, of course, for your added enjoyment, we’ve taken the liberty of pressing the whole thing on a beautiful 2-disc set, featuring Pretty Patrick Pink & Wizard Green Vinyl sure to make you “ooh” and “ahh” the second it’s unsheathed. What will it be sheathed in, you ask? Glad you did: We collaborated with series creator Natasha Allegri to produce all-new illustrated art of your favorite freelancing duo, including both nostalgically warm cover art and some sick center labels. 

So go ahead: Open up a window, grab a big ol’ bowl of candy, put this record on, and let all those early-twenties-troubles sweetly melt away.
