products.title: Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye is decidedly darker than its predecessor, and the accompanying musical score follows suit. Sure, the base game’s music takes an occasional turn toward the dark & mysterious, but for Echoes of the Eye, composer Andrew Prahlow slammed down on those thrusters hard. The result is a more alien and sometimes even more hostile take on the Outer Wilds audio universe, dipping into echoing choral arrangements and staccato soundscapes that remind one of the unforgiving emptiness of space. The true achievement of this score, then, is the way that it evokes all those primal fears of cosmic smallness while still maintaining an undeniably compelling beauty. 

Enter those soundscapes again and again through the magic of your turntable on the Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye Vinyl Soundtrack. Within its Black Hole vinyl grooves, you’ll find the entire Echoes of the Eye score, from “Into Shadow” kicking off Side A all the way to the “Postlude,” very likely the final notes you’ll hear at the end of your Outer Wilds journey. 

It’s a trip through celestial grandeur, presented in a humble-but-stellar cloth-wrapped tip-on gatefold jacket featuring album art from Mobius Digital’s own Ian Jacobson. That jacket, of course, is designed to complement the look of our fan-favorite Outer Wilds 2xLP Vinyl Soundtrack release, echoing its evocative and now-iconic look while cementing its side-by-side position on your record shelf. It’s time to complete your Outer Wilds vinyl collection.

products.title: Steven Spielberg Presents Animaniacs (Soundtrack from the Original Series) Vinyl
products.body_html:
Animaniacs was a golden moment in television history, a bona-fide & fully-featured animated variety show harkening back to the early days of American cartoons featuring short skits, biting satirical wit, and, of course, ludicrously catchy tunes. 

Impressively orchestrated and lyrically playful, music was a part of Animaniacs’ core identity from the show’s very beginning. Original songs were built into the show’s DNA and set the series’ signature tone — sometimes educational, oftentimes irreverent, and always, always gut-bustingly hilarious. 

Surprisingly, this classic music has never before been collected on vinyl. We at iam8bit are teaming up with our friends at WaterTower Music to correct that. 

Introducing…Steven Spielberg Presents Animaniacs (Soundtrack from the Original Series) Vinyl Soundtrack! Meme-spawning classics like “Yakko’s World” and silly send-ups like “I Am the Very Model of A Cartoon Individual” are all represented here, performed by The Animaniacs themselves and presented in their full glory on classic black vinyl. 

But what would Animaniacs be without golden-age-inspired cel-tacular cartoon art? We tapped an absolutely prolific cabal of iconic Animaniacs alumni, new and old: Original character artist Dan Haskett, who has touched classics like Scooby-Doo!, and Looney Tunes, storyboard artist Tony Craig, whose expansive credits include Ben 10 and House of Mouse, and Roman Laney, who helped build El Tigre, Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time, and so much more. These are giants of American animation, and we are humbled to help bring their creations to you. To ensure absolute historic perfection, the whole project was also creatively directed by cartoony expert Gabe Swarr, executive producer of the Animaniacs show revival.

It’s Animaney, totally insane-y, (here’s the product’s name-y!)...It’s the Animaniacs Vinyl Soundtrack! 

And those, friends, are indeed the facts.

products.title: Persona 3 Reload 4xLP
products.body_html:
Persona 3 Reload is a full reimagining of a pivotal entry in Atlus’ flagship roleplaying series, boasting cutting-edge graphics, retuned gameplay, updated character designs, and of course, BRAND-NEW MUSIC. 

The Persona 3 Reload soundtrack pays tribute to the distinctive late-2000s style of the original game while still providing a decidedly modern sound. Its suite of “Reloaded” tracks playfully evoke themes and melodies from their original tunes while bringing in unexpected elements that enhance the experience and create something wholly original. At the same time, that unmistakable Persona swagger is still there by the bucketful, as Atlus Sound Team deftly weaves across genres and influences spanning opera, hip-hop, house, and more. 

Make no mistake: This is a new Persona soundtrack that stands firmly on its own two legs. And as such, it deserves the full iam8bit treatment. We were all too happy to oblige. 

The Persona 3 Reload 4xLP features the “Reloaded” soundtrack, pressed on wax across 4 beautiful Holographic Broken Glass Vinyl discs. Enjoy upbeat head-bobbers like “When the Moon’s Reaching Out” as well as slow, moving melodies like “Aria of the Soul” again & again, given the premium mastering treatment they deserve.

How’s it presented? C’mon – this is a Persona x iam8bit release. You know the sturdy box set packaging is going to be premium, featuring stellar album art by Drew Wise that, dare we say, Reloads the distinctive aesthetic of the game itself. It all comes together to create a S.E.E.S-worthy release that you’ll no doubt spin again & again.

products.title: Five Nights at Freddy’s Vinyl Soundtrack
products.body_html:
The premise for Five Nights at Freddy’s is inspired by and tinged with familiar nostalgia from our collective childhoods — pizza parties at the family amusement center in Anytown, USA, presided over by archaic animatronic creatures who fancy themselves a rock band.

We always knew there was a darkness there, amongst the dusty game cabinets and wobbly tables — something lurking, something… off kilter. It’s a plot that jettisoned Freddy Fazbear and pals into the retrosphere of megastardom — a franchise of countless games, books, and merch drenched in depths of lore, with the feature film from director Emma Tammi (and our pals at Blumhouse and Universal) as the culmination of it all. 

However, an effective horror experience is nothing without its accompanying sound, and The Newton Brothers certainly showed up for this score. From the opening title track, they hypnotize us with the haunting vocals of a children’s choir, cut with the melodies of nursery rhyme horrorshow. It’s a chilling hors d'oeuvre, leading into a pulsing, synthy moody main course that is both a 90s throwback and freshly sinister. How could we expect any less from the boys behind the maniacal music of Midnight Mass, The Haunting of Hill House and Doctor Sleep?

Like all iam8bit releases, the unboxing is part of the fun, too, with four collectible character jackets featuring everyone’s favorite funtime gang — Freddy, Chica, Foxy and Bonnie — adorned with glow-in-the-dark eyes, ensuring even while listening in total darkness, you’ll have company. Minted on delicious Pizza Party Red vinyl, it’s an absolute feast for fans.

It’s a killer soundtrack, but be careful. You never know what other surprises could be waiting inside…

products.title: Sea of Stars (Xbox Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Sabotage Studio has made a reputation of blending retro aesthetics with modern game design methods to create new, wholly original experiences like The Messenger — something we here at iam8bit absolutely adore. And their latest game is their most ambitious masterwork yet. 


So you can see why we’re practically bursting with excitement about this announcement. iam8bit and Sabotage have teamed up to bring you Sea of Stars on glorious physical media — exactly the way that a loving tribute to ‘90s-era RPGs should be experienced. 


Sea of Stars pays homage to the great RPGs of the genre’s golden age, but with distinctly Sabotage-style twists that modernize the experience in electrifying ways; seamless platformer-style traversal through a gorgeous overworld, engaging and innovative tweaks to classic turn-based combat, dozens of original characters aboard in a captivating, epic tale, and breathtaking, crisp 2D pixel-art that pushes the boundaries of what’s possible on a screen.

products.title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk (Xbox Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is Team Reptile’s tribute to late ‘90s/early 2000s skater culture – a time of sick grinds, sick rides, and sick beats. products.title: Oh Deer Diner Thermos by Airam (Alan Wake II)
products.body_html:
Escaping from a living nightmare is no easy task. Even the most tenacious author-turned-hero needs a coffee break every now and then. 

It’s no wonder, then, that the Oh Deer Diner Thermos has gained such a cult following among Alan Wake 2 fans. Scattered throughout the game world, these thermoses act as little blue beacons of hope shining brightly in a world full of horrors, letting Alan and Saga enjoy a brief moment of respite as they save their games. 

Developer Remedy Entertainment has teamed up with Airam, a legendary Finnish manufacturer, to bring these Oh Deer Diner thermos bottles to life. This partnership between two iconic Finnish companies marks the first time Airam has collaborated with another brand. The result? A high-quality, physical extension of the gaming experience for diehard Alan Wake fans. 

Its appearance is true to the light blue thermos bottles featured in both Alan Wake and Alan Wake II. Inside, this limited edition thermos features a high-quality glass interior — the same as Airam’s traditional 0.45 liter bottle. 

iam8bit is humbled to play a key role in distributing this unique item to fans worldwide, for this special release celebrating 30 years of Remedy Entertainment. It’s an artfully delightful representation of Airam and Remedy’s shared commitment to high-quality design.
